title: LLM.int8(): 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale
authors: T. Dettmers, M. Lewis, Y. Belkada, L. Zettlemoyer
inst: U. Washington / Meta AI / Hugging Face
before: Running a 175B model meant a multi-GPU server holding 16-bit weights.
problem: Naive 8-bit quantization destroyed accuracy because of rare outlier features.
breakthrough: Quantize almost everything to 8-bit while keeping outlier dimensions in 16-bit, with no measured degradation.
why: It halved the memory needed to run big models and started the quantization toolchain most local inference uses.
next: GPTQ and AWQ pushed to 4-bit; QLoRA made 4-bit trainable.
inherits: Quantized inference as the normal way to run a model you did not train.
